decisions.state_note: o000: window near x117–181, y67–131 shows pale material with faint vertical gray folds; no outer contour clearly visible. Class uncertain.

o001: window x117–181, y35–99 shows pale material below a dark upper region; upper contour rises near x127,y53 then slopes down toward y65 on the right. A short left-side transition is visible. Class remains uncertain.

o002: window x85–149,y35–99 shows a pale region with a left contour rising rightward from about x108,y96 to x124,y54, then a roughly horizontal upper edge. Detector marks the bend and a short vertical transition; garment type remains uncertain.

o003: window x85–149,y67–131 shows a curved dark-to-pale boundary descending leftward from about x116,y68 to x86,y119, with pale material on the right. Detector labels a shoulder-like bend; class remains uncertain.

o004: window x85–149,y99–163 shows pale textured material, a dark upper-left corner, and a narrow bright roughly horizontal ridge near y155, also detected as a lower rim. Content below the ridge is mostly cropped; class uncertain.

o005: window x85–149,y131–195 shows pale material above a bright lower ridge sloping upward rightward around y170–156, with black below. Detector marks two portions of this ridge. Footwear is a hypothesis; left extent remains unseen.

o006: window x53–117,y131–195 shows pale textured material above a bright lower ridge near y170, with black below; detector marks ridge portions near x84 and x106. Footwear remains a hypothesis; left contour is outside this view.

o007: window x21–85,y131–195 shows pale material with a gently rising upper edge near y140 and a lower bright boundary around y162–175, black below. Detector marks a lower ridge near x53,y162. Footwear hypothesis persists; full outline unknown.

o008: window x21–85,y99–163 shows black above a pale edge rising rightward from about y138 to y122, with pale material below. No detector features. This supports a low leftward extension; ankle boot and sneaker remain hypotheses.

o009: window x53–117,y99–163 shows a pale upper edge rising rightward from about (54,135) to (110,101), black above and textured pale material below. No detector features. Footwear remains likely; ankle boot versus sneaker is unresolved.
o010: window x85–149,y99–163 again shows pale textured material, dark above-left, and a bright lower ridge near (137,155), consistent with prior footwear evidence. Right outline remains unseen.

o011: window x117–181,y99–163 shows pale material with vertical gray folds and a bright lower ridge near y154, matching the detector. Right outer contour remains outside the view; ankle boot versus sneaker is unresolved.
o012: window x149–213,y99–163 shows pale material with vertical gray streaks and a bright lower ridge near y154, matching the detector. Right contour remains unseen; ankle boot remains a hypothesis.
o013: window x149–213,y67–131 shows pale material with faint vertical gray streaks throughout; no clear physical contour or detector features. Right extent remains unknown.

o014: window x160–224,y67–131 shows pale vertically streaked material ending at a near-vertical dark boundary around x217, consistent with detector segments. Upper-right contour remains unseen; ankle boot is a hypothesis.

o015: window x160–224,y35–99 shows pale material beneath a dark upper region, with an uneven upper edge around y56–65 and a near-vertical right boundary at x217. Together with the previously observed low leftward extension and bright lower ridge, this supports an ankle boot.
